name: Inter-Outlet Transit Aging
query:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), se.posting_date) <= 3 THEN '🟢 0-3d'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), se.posting_date) <= 7 THEN '🟡 4-7d'
        ELSE '🔴 8+d'
    END                                          AS `Severity:Data:100`,
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), se.posting_date)         AS `Days in GIT:Int:110`,
    se.name                                      AS `Transit SE:Link/Stock Entry:150`,
    se.posting_date                              AS `Posted On:Date:100`,
    se.from_warehouse                            AS `From Outlet:Link/Warehouse:180`,
    sei.item_code                                AS `Item:Link/Item:130`,
    sei.qty                                      AS `Qty Sent:Float:90`,
    COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(sei2.qty)
        FROM `tabStock Entry` se2
        JOIN `tabStock Entry Detail` sei2 ON sei2.parent = se2.name
        WHERE se2.docstatus = 1
          AND se2.stock_entry_type IN ('Material Transfer', 'Receive at Warehouse')
          AND se2.outgoing_stock_entry = se.name
          AND sei2.item_code = sei.item_code
    ), 0)                                         AS `Qty Received:Float:100`,
    sei.qty - COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(sei2.qty)
        FROM `tabStock Entry` se2
        JOIN `tabStock Entry Detail` sei2 ON sei2.parent = se2.name
        WHERE se2.docstatus = 1
          AND se2.stock_entry_type IN ('Material Transfer', 'Receive at Warehouse')
          AND se2.outgoing_stock_entry = se.name
          AND sei2.item_code = sei.item_code
    ), 0)                                         AS `Qty Remaining:Float:110`,
    sei.uom                                       AS `UOM:Data:60`,
    se.remarks                                    AS `Remarks:Data:220`
FROM `tabStock Entry` se
JOIN `tabStock Entry Detail` sei ON sei.parent = se.name
WHERE se.docstatus = 1
  AND se.stock_entry_type IN ('Material Transfer', 'Send to Warehouse')
  AND (sei.t_warehouse = 'Goods In Transit - SCL' OR se.to_warehouse = 'Goods In Transit - SCL')
  AND (sei.qty - COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(sei2.qty)
        FROM `tabStock Entry` se2
        JOIN `tabStock Entry Detail` sei2 ON sei2.parent = se2.name
        WHERE se2.docstatus = 1
          AND se2.stock_entry_type IN ('Material Transfer', 'Receive at Warehouse')
          AND se2.outgoing_stock_entry = se.name
          AND sei2.item_code = sei.item_code
      ), 0)) > 0.0001
ORDER BY se.posting_date ASC

name: PR Discharge Reconciliation
query:
SELECT
    pr.name                              AS `PR:Link/Purchase Receipt:150`,
    pr.posting_date                       AS `Date:Date:100`,
    pr.supplier                           AS `Supplier:Link/Supplier:180`,
    pr.workflow_state                     AS `Workflow:Data:100`,
    pr.total_qty                          AS `Loaded (kg):Float:100`,
    COALESCE(pr.total_discharged_qty, 0)  AS `Discharged (kg):Float:110`,
    COALESCE(pr.remaining_in_git_qty, pr.total_qty)  AS `In GIT (kg):Float:100`,
    pr.discharge_status                   AS `Discharge:Data:100`,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT se.name)
     FROM `tabStock Entry` se
     WHERE se.pr_reference_new = pr.name AND se.docstatus = 1)  AS `# SEs:Int:60`,
    pr.discharge_closed_by                AS `Closed By:Link/User:140`,
    pr.discharge_closed_at                AS `Closed At:Datetime:140`
FROM `tabPurchase Receipt` pr
WHERE pr.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY pr.posting_date DESC, pr.creation DESC

name: Transit Loss Recovery Aging
query:
SELECT
    c.name                              AS `Case ID:Link/Transit Loss Variance Case:150`,
    c.opening_date                       AS `Opened:Date:100`,
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), c.opening_date)  AS `Days Open:Int:80`,
    c.workflow_state                     AS `Status:Data:100`,
    c.resolution                         AS `Resolution:Data:140`,
    c.hauler_type                        AS `Hauler Type:Data:100`,
    COALESCE(c.hauler, c.in_house_driver) AS `Culpable Party:Data:160`,
    c.qty_dispatched                     AS `Dispatched:Float:100`,
    c.qty_received                       AS `Received:Float:100`,
    (c.qty_dispatched - c.qty_received)  AS `Shortfall Qty:Float:100`,
    c.value_variance                     AS `Value NGN:Currency/NGN:120`,
    c.resolution_journal_entry           AS `Recovery JE:Link/Journal Entry:150`,
    c.assigned_to                        AS `Assigned To:Link/User:180`
FROM `tabTransit Loss Variance Case` c
WHERE c.docstatus < 2
ORDER BY c.docstatus ASC, c.opening_date DESC

name: IFRS Stock Classification
query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(i.sungas_ifrs_category, ''), '(not classified)') AS `IFRS Category:Data:280`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.item_code)                                    AS `Items:Int:80`,
    SUM(b.actual_qty)                                              AS `Qty on Hand:Float:130`,
    SUM(b.stock_value)                                             AS `Stock Value:Currency:170`
FROM `tabBin` b
JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = b.item_code
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
